description.zh:
系统架构。取值范围： 

- i386。
- x86_64。
- arm64。

默认值：x86_64。
description.en:
The system architecture. Valid values: 

- i386.
- x86_64.
- arm64.

Default value: x86_64.

description.zh:
修改镜像的启动模式。取值范围：

- BIOS：BIOS启动模式。
- UEFI：UEFI启动模式。

默认值：BIOS。如果`Architecture=arm64`，则该参数默认值为UEFI，且只能设置为UEFI。

<notice>

为了避免使用镜像不支持的启动模式导致实例无法正常启动，请您务必在选择该参数之前了解目标镜像支持的启动模式。镜像启动模式详情，请参见[镜像启动模式](~~2244655#b9caa9b8bb1wf~~)。

</notice>
description.en:
The boot mode of the image. Valid values:

- BIOS: BIOS boot mode.
- UEFI: UEFI boot mode.

Default value: BIOS. If `Architecture=arm64`, the default value is UEFI, and only UEFI is supported.

<notice>

To prevent instances from failing to start due to an unsupported boot mode, make sure that you understand the boot mode supported by the target image before you set this parameter. For more information about image boot modes, see [Image boot modes](~~2244655#b9caa9b8bb1wf~~).

</notice>.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

description.zh: 镜像的描述信息。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
description.en: The description of the image. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh:
镜像检测策略，不配置此参数时不触发检测。仅支持标准（Standard）检测模式。

>目前已支持大部分的Linux/Windows版本，关于镜像检测项与操作系统限制说明，请参见[镜像检测概述](~~439819~~)和[镜像检测操作系统限制](~~475800~~)。
description.en:
The image detection strategy. If this parameter is not specified, detection is not triggered. Only the Standard detection mode is supported.

> Most Linux and Windows versions are supported. For more information about image detection items and operating system limitations, see [Image detection overview](~~439819~~) and [Operating system limitations for image detection](~~475800~~).

description.zh: 创建的自定义镜像信息列表。
description.en: The information list of the custom image to create.

description.zh:
指定DiskDeviceMapping.N.Device在自定义镜像中的设备名。

> 该参数即将停止使用，为提高代码兼容性，建议您尽量不要使用该参数。
description.en:
The device name of DiskDeviceMapping.N.Device in the custom image.

> This parameter will be deprecated. For better compatibility, do not use this parameter.

description.zh:
自定义镜像大小。单位：GiB。

该空间由系统盘和数据盘组成，您必须保证系统盘的空间大小大于等于导入的镜像文件大小。取值范围：

- N=1时，表示系统盘，取值范围：1 GiB~2048 GiB。
- N=2~17时，表示数据盘。取值范围：1 GiB~2048 GiB。

当您将源镜像文件上传至OSS后，可以在OSS Bucket中查看镜像文件的大小。

>该参数即将被弃用，为提高兼容性，请尽量使用`DiskDeviceMapping.N.DiskImageSize`参数。
description.en:
The size of the custom image. Unit: GiB.

The size includes the system disk and data disks. Make sure that the system disk space is greater than or equal to the size of the imported image file. Valid values:

- When N is 1, the value specifies the system disk size. Valid values: 1 to 2048.
- When N is 2 to 17, the value specifies the data disk size. Valid values: 1 to 2048.

After you upload the source image file to OSS, you can view the image file size in the OSS bucket.

> This parameter will be deprecated. For better compatibility, use `DiskDeviceMapping.N.DiskImageSize`.

description.zh:
导入镜像后，自定义镜像的空间大小。

该空间由系统盘和数据盘组成，您必须保证系统盘的空间大小大于等于导入的镜像文件大小。取值范围：

- N=1时，表示系统盘，取值范围：1 GiB~2048 GiB。
- N=2~17时，表示数据盘。取值范围：1 GiB~2048 GiB。

当您将源镜像文件上传至OSS后，可以在OSS Bucket中查看镜像文件的大小。
description.en:
The size of the custom image after the image is imported.

The size includes the system disk and data disks. Make sure that the system disk space is greater than or equal to the size of the imported image file. Valid values:

- When N is 1, the value specifies the system disk size. Valid values: 1 to 2048. Unit: GiB.
- When N is 2 to 17, the value specifies the data disk size. Valid values: 1 to 2048. Unit: GiB.

After you upload the source image file to OSS, you can view the image file size in the OSS bucket.

description.zh:
镜像格式。取值范围：

- RAW。
- VHD。
- QCOW2。
- VMDK（邀测中）。

默认值：无，表示阿里云自动检测镜像格式，以检测格式为准。
description.en:
The image format. Valid values:

- RAW.
- VHD.
- QCOW2.
- VMDK (in invitational preview).

Default value: null, which indicates that Alibaba Cloud automatically detects the image format. The detected format prevails.

description.zh:
镜像文件所在的OSS Bucket。

> 首次导入镜像到该OSS Bucket前，请参见本文档的**接口说明**添加RAM授权策略，否则会报错`NoSetRoletoECSServiceAccount`。
description.en:
The OSS bucket where the image file is stored.

> Before you import an image to this OSS bucket for the first time, add the RAM authorization policy as described in the **Operation description** section of this topic. Otherwise, the `NoSetRoletoECSServiceAccount` error is returned.

description.zh: 镜像上传至OSS Bucket后，保存在Bucket中的镜像文件的文件名（key）。
description.en: The file name (key) of the image file stored in the OSS bucket after the image is uploaded to OSS.

description.zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值范围：

- true：发送检查请求，不会查询资源状况。检查项包括AccessKey是否有效、RAM用户的授权情况和是否填写了必需参数。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
- false：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回 2XX HTTP状态码并直接查询资源状况。

默认值：false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run. Valid values:

- true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including invalid AccessKey pairs, unauthorized RAM users, and missing parameter values. If the request fails the dry run, the corresponding error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
- false: performs a dry run and sends the request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2XX HTTP status code is returned and the resource status is queried.

Default value: false.

description.zh: 镜像特性相关属性。
description.en: The image feature-related properties.

description.zh: 镜像名称。长度为2~128个字符。必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。可以包含数字、半角句号（.）、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。
description.en: The name of the image. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, periods (.), colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-).

description.zh:
许可证类型，预设该镜像在创建实例（[RunInstances](~~2679677~~)）时的授权模式。该值仅对 Windows Server 类型镜像生效。取值范围：
- Aliyun：使用阿里云官方许可。启动实例后，系统将尝试自动连接阿里云 KMS 服务器进行激活。该实例的计费中将包含 Windows Server许可费。
- BYOL：自带许可 (Bring Your Own License)。启动实例后，阿里云不会对其进行自动激活。您需使用自有的合法许可密钥手动激活。该实例的计费中不会包含 Windows Server许可费。

默认值：Aliyun。
description.en:
The license type. This parameter specifies the authorization mode when instances are created by calling [RunInstances](~~2679677~~) with the image. This value takes effect only for Windows Server images. Valid values:
- Aliyun: Use the Alibaba Cloud official license. After the instance starts, the system attempts to automatically connect to the Alibaba Cloud KMS server for activation. The billing for the instance includes the Windows Server license fee.
- BYOL: Bring Your Own License. After the instance starts, Alibaba Cloud does not automatically activate it. You must manually activate it by using your own valid license key. The billing for the instance does not include the Windows Server license fee.

Default value: Aliyun.

description.zh:
操作系统类型。取值范围： 

- windows。需要同时设置`LicenseType`。
- linux。

默认值：linux。
description.en:
The operating system type. Valid values: 

- windows. You must also set `LicenseType`.
- linux.

Default value: linux.

The operating system version. Valid values:

- Anolis
- CentOS
- Ubuntu

description.zh: 源自定义镜像的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID of the source custom image. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 导入镜像所在的企业资源组ID。
description.en: The ID of the enterprise resource group to which the imported image belongs.

description.zh: 导入镜像时，使用的RAM角色名称。
description.en: The name of the RAM role used to import the image.

description.zh:
指定云盒的资源名称（ARN），用于唯一标识云端存储位置。

>仅当您需要从OSS ON云盒中导入镜像文件时，才需提供此参数的值。如果您使用的存储服务不是OSS ON云盒，则无需设置此参数。更多信息，请参见[什么是OSS ON云盒](~~430190~~)。

正确的ARN格式应遵循：`arn:acs:cloudbox:{RegionId}:{AliUid}:cloudbox/{CloudBoxId}`的模式，其中`{RegionId}`应替换为云盒实际所在的地域ID，`{AliUid}`是阿里云账号（主账号）ID，而`{CloudBoxId}`是云盒ID。
description.en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the CloudBox, which is used to uniquely identify the cloud storage location.

> You need to specify this parameter only when you import an image file from OSS on CloudBox. If you do not use OSS on CloudBox, do not set this parameter. For more information, see [What is OSS on CloudBox](~~430190~~).

The ARN must follow this format: `arn:acs:cloudbox:{RegionId}:{AliUid}:cloudbox/{CloudBoxId}`, where `{RegionId}` is the region ID of the CloudBox, `{AliUid}` is the Alibaba Cloud account ID, and `{CloudBoxId}` is the CloudBox ID.

description.zh: 镜像的标签列表。
description.en: The tags of the image.

description.zh: 镜像的标签键。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或者`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The key of the image tag. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 镜像的标签值。N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The value of the image tag. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs import-image --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-name ImageTestName --description TestDescription --architecture x86_64 --os-type linux --platform Aliyun --boot-mode BIOS --role-name AliyunECSImageImportDefaultRole --license-type BYOL --resource-group-id rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --disk-device-mapping Format=QCOW2 OSSObject=CentOS_5.4_32.raw Device=example-string DiskImSize=80 DiskImageSize=80 OSSBucket=ecsimageos --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --detection-strategy Standard --storage-location-arn arn:acs:cloudbox:cn-hangzhou:123456:cloudbox/cb-xx000123 --dry-run false --features NvmeSupport=supported ImdsSupport=v2 --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ecs ImportImage --region cn-hangzhou --DetectionStrategy Standard --DiskDeviceMapping.1.DiskImageSize 80 --Features.ImdsSupport v2 --Tag.1.Key TestKey --Description TestDescription --Architecture x86_64 --Platform Aliyun --ResourceGroupId 'rg-bp67acfmxazb4p0000' --DiskDeviceMapping.1.Device 'example-string' --BootMode BIOS --StorageLocationArn 'arn:acs:cloudbox:cn-hangzhou:123456:cloudbox/cb-xx000123' --DryRun false --DiskDeviceMapping.1.OSSObject 'CentOS_5.4_32.raw' --DiskDeviceMapping.1.DiskImSize 80 --LicenseType BYOL --Features.NvmeSupport supported --ImageName ImageTestName --DiskDeviceMapping.1.Format QCOW2 --RoleName AliyunECSImageImportDefaultRole --OSType linux --Tag.1.Value TestValue --DiskDeviceMapping.1.OSSBucket ecsimageos --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000' --method POST --force
